finding.detail: klayout-tools==0.8.0 (signoff/requirements.txt) does not read a request-level placement density: place_and_route.py defines the module constant _GLOBAL_PLACEMENT_DENSITY = 0.6 and place_and_route_script.py emits `global_placement -density 0.6` with no request override (a request field was only added upstream after 0.8.0, klayout-tools #4716, present in 0.9.x). Unknown top-level request keys are not rejected, so this trial's `placement_density: 0.45` was silently ignored: the run was a byte-equivalent baseline replica, not a trial of any setting.
proof: trials/ext_mem_instr/placement-density-0p45/.klt/place-and-route/pnr_ext_mem_instr_place.tcl line 7: `global_placement -density 0.6 -routability_driven -timing_driven -random_seed 1` (unchanged from baseline despite placement_density=0.45 in request.json)
klayout-tools 0.8.0 place_and_route.py load_request()/run(): no `request.get("placement_density")`; first appears in 0.9.x citing issue #4716
